The project tracking tool your whole team will actually use daily

Northwind keeps every project, document, and decision in one place your team already lives. No migration project, no training videos.

Plan together

Roadmaps, sprints, and backlogs share one data model, so a change in planning shows up in execution immediately and nobody pastes screenshots into chat to stay aligned.

Ship faster

Automations move work forward while you sleep: triage, assignment, status rollups, and release notes draft themselves from the work your team already recorded.

Stay aligned

Every goal links to the projects behind it, so progress updates write themselves and leadership sees the same numbers as the people doing the work.
